name: second-opinion
description: Summon a second-opinion reviewer (advisor) over your current session: mechanically extract the conversation context and send it unedited to Codex (gpt-5 series) and/or Fable (claude-fable-5) backends, which return a fixed five-section verdict (blind spots, convergence, ship/no-ship, decisive constraint, strongest counterargument). Backend, model, and effort are selectable at call time.
